description: Verify a registered DPX agent and receive a signed 1-hour credential. Returns KYA level, effective spend caps (tier or mandate), owner verification status, mandate active status, and FATF R.16 compliance attestation. Attach credential.signature as X-Agent-Credential header and agentId as X-Agent-Id header on DPX /settle requests — enables mandate enforcement, per-agent audit trail, and FATF attestation. Credential expires in 1 hour; call again to refresh before expiry.
name: agent.kya_verify
